title: More pieces than characters
objective: Build one grapheme cluster containing at least three Unicode scalars.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: Combine marks or use an emoji ZWJ sequence.

graphDescription: ICU4X counts extended grapheme clusters independently from scalars.
hints: Combining marks can extend a base without starting a new grapheme.
Emoji joined by U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER can also form one cluster.
Try e followed by U+0301 and U+0323.
explanation: User-perceived characters are grapheme clusters, not fixed-width storage units. One cluster can contain a base plus several marks, or an entire emoji ZWJ sequence.
